scope: Bounded exact symbolic computation: exact rational arithmetic, polynomial factorization/coefficient extraction, algebraic roots, symbolic differentiation, exact definite integration, exact determinant, finite combinatorial sum, exact limit, rational linear system, and series coefficient.
selection_reason: First V4 cycle chosen for maximum proof velocity: exact ground truth gives a hard 100% capability ceiling, a deterministic zero-dollar supplier exists, and success establishes the full obsolescence machinery without subjective frontier-model judging.

frontier_bar.rationale: For tasks with unique exact mathematical ground truth, no system can exceed 100% exact correctness. Reaching 100% therefore reaches the frontier ceiling for the bounded task class.

external_frontier_context.note: Frontier model advertised for multidisciplinary reasoning and tool use; not used as ground-truth producer.
Frontier reasoning model with reported math/science benchmarks; not used as ground-truth producer.

promotion_rule: Promote to OBSOLETE_VERIFIED only if the frozen suite passes 12/12 exactly at $0 and independent Wolfram expected values are consistent with the producer outputs. Scope must remain bounded to the tested exact-symbolic operation classes.
anti_overclaim: This record does not claim that mathematical reasoning, scientific reasoning, theorem proving, word-problem reasoning, or all symbolic mathematics are obsolete.
